scope: Internal AgentManager root tree, including synchronous context preparation and provider planning; independent native/runner limits remain separately declared

units.steps: Atomic exact tool-call position reservations, not tokens or completed effects
units.seconds: Sum of active-worker seconds including concurrent planning/provider work; human approval and child-decision waits paused

durable_tables: Root grant/version, task membership, exact reservations, active leases and atomic approval-resume receipt in AgentStore SQLite
boundaries: All-or-nothing group reservation and idempotent exact retry
Cancellation releases active lease but never resets pool usage
Startup uncertain leases exhaust time and require explicit renewal
Approval decision, grant update and restart receipt commit atomically
Approved sibling/restart continuation reuses same grant and ignores invented client increases
Planning renewal resumes planning and requires separate plan approval before tools
Partial tool time exhaustion does not automatically replay effects

checks.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_tree_budget.py tests/test_agent.py -q -k "tree_budget or budget or subagent"

limitations: Actual concurrent coordinator/provider/tool fixtures use local deterministic adapters, never paid providers.
This record does not claim final rendered shared-budget UI or installed runtime proof.
Existing individual token/cost accounting is not invented; pool units remain reserved calls and summed active seconds.
